item.title: BillyBoy - PG Practice
item.description: Summary Initial Foothold can be gain through password guessing or bruteforcing common passwords. After that Sonatype Nexus application remote code execution vulnerability can be exploited and gain Remote Code Execution on the target. Finally, the SMBGhost vulnerability can be exploited to escalate privileges. Enumeration Nmap We’ll start off with a simple Nmap scan. kali@kali:~$ sudo nmap 192.168.140.61 Starting Nmap 7.80 ( https://nmap.org ) at 2021-01-05 01:33 EST Nmap scan report for 192.
